lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical white stripes traversing the lateral torso; spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-section with slightly denser clustering at the posterior-most region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first and second anterior stripes terminate mid-torso; stripes 9 and 10 show fragmentation into dashed segments near the ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of approximately 7 high-contrast white spots located on the upper posterior haunch and lateral thigh area.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots on the infraorbital region and one larger white spot on the lower cheek; presence of a white transverse patch on the lower neck/throat area.
